question: Will James Comey have at least two federal criminal cases pending against him on November 13, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Status quo (Oct 30): two pending cases. Main risk is the D.D.C. information: Judge McFadden appeared skeptical that an information satisfies the 10-yr NDI limitations provision but deferred ruling pending DOJ's attempt to get a D.C. grand jury indictment by the Nov 5 Speedy Trial deadline. If indicted (~55%), case almost surely still pending Nov 13; if no-bill/no indictment, dismissal before Nov 13 is fairly likely (~65%). D.C. grand juries have refused politically charged indictments; prior DOJ probes of this leak declined charges. E.D.N.C. motions ripe since Sept but undecided; arraignment set Jan 2027, so full dismissal in next 10 days ~5-6%. No matching human market (Manifold conviction market at 4% is a different contract). Net ~0.65*0.94 = ~0.6.
